lessons_used: Reordering sign-in until after pet adoption was effective and slightly outperformed predictions (+13.3% measured vs +12.0% predicted).
Home page redesigns like interactive waiting rooms are helpful (+5.6% measured), though initial predictions were too high (+8.0% predicted).
Adoption incentives like photo quality guides and companion previews improved results (+7.6% measured), but were overestimated (+10.0% predicted).

candidates.title: Story Narrative Companion Carousel Redesign
candidates.change: Replace the standard story intro layout with a split view animated preview showcasing interactive pet moments before users pick a path.
candidates.why: choose_path has a 23.8% drop-off rate and a high mean completion time of 514s, showing initial hesitation during story introduction.

intro_story.text: Choose how you want to bring your pet to life.

guard.reason: replacement for 'story.intro_story' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['animation', 'image', 'mascot', 'video'] with an asset:story/ asset

candidates.title: Pet Personality Calibration Screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated pet personality choice screen before photo upload so users can define their pet's interactive traits.
candidates.why: The adoption step drops 37% of users and takes 1017s mean; custom personality choice creates immediate ownership and engagement.

guard.reason: _order names screens that are neither onboarding screens nor defined here: ['new_personality']

candidates.title: Move Sign-In to Onboarding Hand-off
candidates.change: Reorder the sign-in step to occur right after pet generation finishes, immediately before introducing the pet on the desktop.
candidates.why: 8 support tickets cited pets missing after logging back in; placing sign-in right before desktop delivery reinforces cloud sync.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in to occur after waiting/adoption is explicitly allowed by rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Reordering sign-in directly addresses 8 support tickets and matches proven historical lift (+13.3%).

candidates.title: Interactive Mini Games Waiting Experience
candidates.change: Rebuild the waiting screen into a dynamic stage layout equipped with companion interaction mini-games while asset rendering takes place.
candidates.why: Home waiting step has a long median duration of 201s (mean 2336s); active entertainment reduces abandonments while pets render.

components.text: Play while your pet gets ready!

guard.reason: 'waiting.components[1]': timer text must read like 'About 4 min left' (at most 30 min)

candidates.title: Cloud Save Status & Sync Assurance Badge
candidates.change: Display a prominent cloud save assurance hint and status badge on the sign-in screen.
candidates.why: 8 emails reported pets missing or reset after signing in again; clear messaging prevents confusion about saved pet data.

sign_in.hint: Your adopted pet and custom settings are automatically saved to this account.

guard.reason: Adding a cloud save status hint and badge to the sign-in screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: High evidence (8 emails) and config-only change, but sign-in step drop is moderate.

candidates.title: Custom Pet Generation Guarantee Badge
candidates.change: Add a satisfaction guarantee badge and live quality helper to the photo upload screen.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected rendering, causing adoption drop-offs.

upload_photos.hint: Free instant retries included until your pet looks exactly how you want!

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions 'Free instant retries', which violates rule 3 forbidding mentions of prices, discounts, gifts, or free extras.

candidates.title: Desktop Interaction Shortcut Checklist Layout
candidates.change: Change the home intro layout to a checklist format outlining primary pet commands like hiding, moving, and chatting.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the desktop pet.

home_intro.headline: How to Interact With Your Pet

home_welcome.text: Click pet to chat • Drag to move • Double-click tray to hide

candidates.title: Live 3D Render Hatching Progress Tracker
candidates.change: Enable live progress percentage bar and detailed status updates during the pet creation wait screen.
candidates.why: The waiting step mean time reaches 2336s; explicit progress indicators assure users the desktop app is actively working.

waiting.hint: Generating 3D mesh and animations for your companion...

guard.reason: Adding progress indicators and live status updates to the waiting screen is explicitly allowed.

candidates.score_note: Addresses extreme mean wait time (2336s) at home step, but requires custom UI build.

candidates.title: System Tray Location & Shortcut Notification Tip
candidates.change: Add a reminder hint showing users where the app lives in the desktop taskbar and how to summon the pet.
candidates.why: 3 support messages noted pets failing to display on desktop or users unable to re-open the app after setup.

home_intro.hint: Look for your pet on your desktop! Use the system tray icon to show or hide your companion anytime.

components.text: Tip: Press Ctrl+Shift+P to summon your pet instantly.

guard.reason: Adding system tray location hints and shortcut tips to the home intro screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Targets high finish step drop (35.2%) with minimal config-only tip implementation.

candidates.title: Simplified Onboarding Path Selection Copy
candidates.change: Revise the choose_path headline and body copy to clearly differentiate instant starter pets from photo custom creations.
candidates.why: choose_path mean duration is 514s despite low median (8s), showing long-tail confusion when selecting an adoption path.

choose_path.headline: Choose How to Adopt Your Companion
choose_path.body: Pick a ready-to-play starter pet in seconds, or create a unique companion from your own photos.

guard.reason: Updating choose_path copy while maintaining both adoption options is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Addresses 514s mean duration confusion on path selection via easy copy tweak.

picked: System Tray Location & Shortcut Notification Tip
lessons_next: Moving sign-in until after pet adoption was effective and slightly outperformed predictions (+13.3% measured vs +12.0% predicted), but moving sign-in to onboarding hand-off showed no clear effect.
Home page redesigns like interactive waiting rooms were helpful (+5.6% measured), though predictions were too high (+8.0% predicted).
Adoption incentives like photo quality guides and companion previews were helpful (+7.6% measured), but were overestimated (+10.0% predicted).
Simplifying onboarding path selection copy showed no clear effect.
Adding live 3D render hatching progress trackers to the home page showed no clear effect.
